'''Liangyu''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is one of the three [[Xuan Triad]] and a quest-exclusive NPC who makes her first appearance during the {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}.

==Profile==

===Resonance===
She is a [[Resonator]], and her [[Tacet Mark]] is located on her nape.
